description: ONE project in depth: its card, its recent journal entries and any active soft-locks. Compact by default — the card's first 4000 chars (frontmatter, digest, facts, next step), the newest 5 journal entries with text cut to 240 chars; full:true gives the whole card and 15 entries. Use after hub_status or hub_search points you at a project.

full.description: return everything, uncapped. By default long lists are trimmed (and, where the description says so, long texts cut) to fit an agent context, and what was left out is reported in `truncated`.

name: hub_get
